description: The file-control COLLATING SEQUENCE clause (ISO 12.4.5.7) - the collating sequence for the record keys of an INDEXED file (Format 1 file-level IS/FOR ALPHANUMERIC/FOR NATIONAL, Format 2 key-level OF key... IS alphabet). 2002 introduction (programmable indexed-key collating); 0900 below 2002. Parses at all editions (superset), introduction-gated post-bind by VersionConformancePass.
vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard - Annex E covers 2014->2023 only)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ROWCOL.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       CONFIGURATION SECTION.
       SPECIAL-NAMES.
           ALPHABET AL IS "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO "f.dat" ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED
               RECORD KEY IS R-KEY
               COLLATING SEQUENCE IS AL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R.
          05 R-KEY PIC X(4).
          05 R-D   PIC X(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN. STOP RUN.
